rv.q: Bioh, perfectly assisted by her sympatico director Whitney White and a no-weak-link cast, has done something quite amazing with this comedy-drama.
"School Girls" is an uproariously funny and heartbreaking portrait of sisterhood framed by the consequences of colonialism, anti-Blackness, and colorism.
Bioh's breakthrough 2017 play about cliques and colorism is just as funny — and devastating — with a sharp ensemble and direction by Whitney White.
Deeply funny, exceptionally smart, and impeccably staged, this School Girls earns top honors.
Smart, serious, and funny in equal measure, School Girls is a comedy you won't want to miss.
Still, every element of this top-of-its-class production has combined to make the production a true crowd-pleaser.
Bitingly witty, this smartly constructed comedy transports us to the Aburi Girls Boarding School in 1986. Ghana.

The Broadway version has a longer running time, a more elaborate set and extravagant costume design, and a starrier cast than the original Off-Broadway production. But it also somehow feels slighter than it did when I saw it in 2017.
At times, Bioh's comedy isn't just about teenagers; it appears to have been written by teenagers.
Jocelyn Bioh's pageant comedy lands its laughs and its reckoning with colorism in equal measure.

cn.t: Bioh's sharp comedy about cliques and colorism at a Ghanaian boarding school earns praise for its humor and emotional depth, with critics applauding the ensemble cast and White's direction in this well-deserved Broadway debut.

dr.inst: Available through the TodayTix app. Limit 2 tickets per person. Seat locations determined at discretion of box office.

vs.sum: The Samuel J. Friedman Theatre offers good sightlines with minimal obstructions and a well-raked mezzanine, ensuring a clear view from most seats. The sound quality is consistently praised, and the seating is comfortable with decent legroom. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its elegant design following renovation, though facilities like restrooms are average, leading to some congestion during intermissions.

acc.note: Elevator to all levels. Built-in induction loop for t-coil hearing aids.
